authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Cut self-disabling or Dalek-specific high-cost cards (blueprint L63).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Missy costs six; losing her twice is very expensive.
Exile-on-death effects (Rest in Peace, Leyline) stop the loop.
Artifact creatures don't return; Cybermen and Missy's own returns can't loop until turned face up.

value.interaction: Terminate, Delete, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge, Swan Song.
value.mana: 35 lands, Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Ancient Tomb, Talismans.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Missy is the recursion engine and a piece in every one of the 17 Spellbook infinites in the list.
accepted_role.honest_note: This is genuinely commander-native: Missy + free outlet + Ruthless Ripper/Dragon's Eye Savants/Horde Ambusher is three cards, two of them tutorable. The cost is a six-mana commander, which the source names as the main reason for Bracket 4 (blueprint L42). The cycle 51 M1 review (missy-01..09, all verified) confirms the loop rules.
